text: chirp#36 (Android): regenerated ActionBuilders.kt via `cargo run -p nmp-codegen -- gen action-builders --platform kotlin`. Only `zap` was actually dropped (NMP #2325 removed zap wallet scope from v1, unrelated to this issue but confirmed real); createPublicGroup/postComment/topicArticles never had Android call sites (confirmed via full-tree grep, matching the issue's own uncertainty). SocialActions.zapNote() now fails closed with a clear "unavailable" message + log line instead of referencing a builder that no longer exists.
